# Virtual Office Space USA

> Real US commercial street addresses (never P.O. Boxes), registered agent service and same-day digital mail scanning for international founders and US businesses. USPS CMRA compliant (Form 1583) and accepted for Mercury, Relay, Brex and Stripe verification.

- Website: https://virtualofficespaceusa.online/
- Email: connect@virtualofficespaceusa.online

- Operated by Stage-X (https://stage-x.space)

## Plans (USD)
- Digital Mail — $19/mo or $199/yr: commercial street address, suite number, envelope scanning, online mailroom, international forwarding
- Business Pro — $39/mo or $389/yr: Digital Mail + registered agent, compliance reminders, bank-ready address proof
- Global Founder Suite — $79/mo or $749/yr: Business Pro + non-resident LLC formation, EIN filing support, US business phone number
